summary: Switches among up to 9999 SOP inputs. The Select Input field chooses the source index, so expressions can drive which geometry stream appears at the output.

key_params.name: input
key_params.note: Select Input field; source index where the first input is 0, the second is 1, and so on.

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Controls out-of-range and negative index behavior: Clamp, Loop, or ZigZag.

common_gotchas: Switch SOP can address up to 9999 inputs, but keep large input banks organized because debugging the selected source becomes harder.
expression-driven switching can change geometry topology over time; monitor Info CHOP num_points and num_prims when downstream SOPs assume stable counts.
Extend controls negative and out of range indices; Clamp, Loop, and ZigZag are explicit routing choices, not error handling.
Select Input is 0-based: input 0 is the first source.
